# AR runtime libraries

- A-Frame 1.5.0, distributed under the MIT license. See `aframe-MIT-LICENSE.txt`.
- MindAR 1.2.5 image-tracking A-Frame build, distributed under the MIT license. See `mindar-MIT-LICENSE.txt`.

These are the upstream browser builds used by MindAR's official A-Frame quick-start example. They are served locally so the AR entry does not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.

Upstream sources:

- https://aframe.io/releases/1.5.0/aframe.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mind-ar@1.2.5/dist/mindar-image-aframe.prod.js
